extracted.name: MeeMaw's 5-Star Coleslaw Dressing
extracted.description: Make up a big batch of this coleslaw dressing recipe, and you'll be ready the next time you have to serve up some coleslaw for a crowd.
ingredient_lines: 1 (32 ounce) jar mayonnaise (such as Best Foods®)
instruction_lines: Whisk sugar and cider vinegar together in a large bowl until sugar has dissolved. Mix in mayonnaise, yellow mustard, celery seed, and salt until thoroughly combined.
